text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
King is joining the Takarazuka Kinen too?! 
Alright, I'll just have to knock her flat 
and claw my way to the top!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, even my junior, 
Vodka-san, is joining in?! It's just like 
a clash between the old and new 
protagonists of PriFai... So hype! I 
simply must not lose this, darling!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now, the cast is all assembled! Let our 
race begin! How about a taste of my 
Princess☆Backbreaker!?
